package rulefixtures

// scenario for make_slice_inside_hot_loop_same_shape: make([]T, ...) scratch slices recreated inside loops instead of being reused.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

func scenario355Positive(items []int) [][]int {
	var batches [][]int
	for i := 0; i < len(items); i += 10 {
		batch := make([]int, 0, 10)
		for j := i; j < i+10 && j < len(items); j++ {
			batch = append(batch, items[j])
		}
		batches = append(batches, batch)
	}
	return batches
}
